messages:
Laura Chen: Hey all — I dropped the company-level goals draft in the drive: https://redwood.drive/company_goals_q3. Need tight alignment on two tradeoffs before EOD: (A) SSO/SCIM — must-have vs MVP, and (B) Redwood Optimize scope — full telemetry & regression alerts vs trimmed v1. Can we decide today?
Matt O'Connor: On it. Quick note: SSO/SCIM feels like P1 for our current sales funnel — we have ~3 deals waiting. If we can't ship full SCIM, we should commit to a clear timeline + interim workaround.
Jess Patel: Agree with Matt. For Optimize, I suggest we ship core cost controls (batching hints, quant recs) and punt advanced regression alerts to v2. Keeps scope tight.
Rajiv Kapoor: From infra: if SSO becomes P1 we'll need ~2 eng-weeks and a security review window. That could push some infra refactor work. Also SLOs for Dedicated might need retuning during rollout.
Sara Nguyen: Customer success here — two enterprise trials are blocked on SSO. Delay = churn risk. An "alpha SSO" with manual onboarding could buy us time.
Tim Lee: Engineering take: alpha SSO (manual provisioning + docs) is doable in ~10 working days. Full SCIM + automated provisioning needs more org time. We can do a canary rollout to protect latency SLOs.
Laura Chen: Sounds like rough consensus: mark SSO as P1 but allow alpha/manual onboarding as fallback. Jess, can you update the draft OKR wording to reflect that? Also we need concrete launch criteria — can folks call out the must-have bullets here?
Jess Patel: Will update now. Proposed launch criteria: 1) 95th%-tile latency within target for gen endpoints (<X ms), errors <10% under load; 2) Alpha SSO available + onboarding docs; 3) Billing, quotas, and Dedicated provisioning validated; 4) Regression checks for our top-5 prompts pass.
Matt O'Connor: Add: two customer acceptance tests — one enterprise customer and one high-volume startup QA run. Prefer these before full GA.
Rajiv Kapoor: Noted. I'll add an infra risk line and a short mitigation plan + estimate in the doc.
Laura Chen: :thumbsup: Great. If nobody objects by 17:00 PT I'll lock the draft and route for exec signoff. @Tim @Jess please ping me immediately if timelines slip.
Tim Lee: :raised_hands: I'll surface any blockers by noon and escalate if needed.
Jess Patel: :white_check_mark: Updated the draft and pushed to drive (same link). Minor wording on telemetry trimmed. I left a short note on the rollout plan.
